description.zh:
分组ID，当**推送模式**选择为**分组设备**时，该项必填。
您可以在**设备管理** > **分组管理**中获取分组ID，
description.en:
The group ID. This parameter is Required when **PushMode** is set to **GROUP_DEVICE**.  
You can obtain the group ID in **Device Management** > **Group Management**.

description.zh:
设备ID。当**推送模式**选择为**单个设备**时，该参数与**ProductKey**、**DeviceName**组合二选一必传。

> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
description.en:
The Device ID. When the **push pattern** is set to **single device**, you must specify either this parameter or the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**.

> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the unique identifier of the device and corresponds one-to-one with the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** combination. If you specify both **IotId** and the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** combination, **IotId** takes precedence.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页签，查看当前实例的ID。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** tab in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must pass this **ID** value. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to pass this parameter.
></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过[项目管理控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID。
description.en: The project ID is the UUID of the project. You can obtain the project ID in the [Project Management Console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects).

description.zh:
推送模式。

- **ALL**：全量设备推送。

- **SINGLE_DEVICE**：单设备推送。

- **GROUP_DEVICE**：分组设备推送。
description.en:
The push pattern.

- **ALL**: Push to all devices.

- **SINGLE_DEVICE**: Push to a single device.

- **GROUP_DEVICE**: Push to a group of devices.

description.zh:
需要推送的语料ID列表。该参数可以通过[QuerySpeechList](~~217576~~)查询获取。

N为整数，取值范围：1~100，表示每次最多推送100条语料。
description.en:
The list of corpus IDs to be pushed. You can obtain this parameter by calling [QuerySpeechList](~~217576~~).

N is an integer ranging from 1 to 100, indicating that up to 100 corpus entries can be pushed at a time.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API under a single Alibaba Cloud account is 10.

> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot push-speech --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --push-mode SINGLE_DEVICE --group-id 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --iot-id 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --project-code 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --device-name light --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --speech-code-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot PushSpeech --region cn-hangzhou --IotId 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --SpeechCodeList.1 'example-string' --ProjectCode 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --PushMode SINGLE_DEVICE --GroupId 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --DeviceName light
